AIAC Aerolec Club – Innovation Beyond the Sky

We are AIAC Aerolec, the aeronautics and robotics club of the Académie Internationale Mohammed VI de l’Aviation Civile (AIAC), Morocco. Our mission is to bring together passionate students who want to explore, design, and develop innovative solutions in aeronautics, robotics, electronics, and emerging technologies. Our team is driven by curiosity, creativity, and a strong spirit of collaboration.
